definition.self_dual_symbols: eta^i_jk=epsilon_ijk and eta^i_j4=delta_ij for i,j,k in {1,2,3}
definition.chiral_connection: A^i_mu(x)=-2 eta^i_munu x^nu/(1-||x||^2), with T_i=-i sigma_i/2
definition.chiral_curvature: F^i_munu(x)=4 eta^i_munu/(1-||x||^2)^2; in the orthonormal frame F^i_ab=eta^i_ab/R^2
definition.geodesic_link: for p,q in B4, w=1-p dot q, b_i=eta^i_munu q^mu p^nu, s=hypot(w,b), U+(q<-p)=(w I-i b_i sigma_i)/s
definition.path_order: for links U_k from p_k to p_(k+1), U_path=U_(n-1)...U_1 U_0
definition.qutrit_lift: rho3_q=diag(1,U_path) rho3_p diag(1,U_path)^dagger; radial flag weight is unchanged
definition.qiskit_projection: append each already-certified SU(2) link as a one-qubit UnitaryGate in path order
definition.flat_control: the matched R4 global coframe has zero connection and identity loop holonomy
definition.sectional_boundary: Mobius operations remain on the H4 base; iH is an SU(2) amplitude/gauge control; nonzero SO(2,2) boosts are not qubit gates

predictions.statement: Every closed-form geodesic link is finite, unitary, determinant one, continuously signed with positive scalar part, identity on a radial edge, and its reverse is the exact adjoint.
The Bloch adjoint of every SU(2)+ link agrees to 1e-10 with the positive self-dual projection of the existing H4 hyperboloid Levi-Civita frame transporter.
Qubit and lifted qutrit density transport preserve Hermiticity, positivity, trace, spectrum, and the QB1 radial-flag weight.
For the geodesic triangle 0->epsilon e1->epsilon e2->0, U=exp[-2 atan(epsilon^2) T3], its H4 area is 2 R^2 atan(epsilon^2), and the matched flat R4 loop is identity.
A plus-x density probe sees triangle trace distance epsilon^2/sqrt(1+epsilon^4) and root fidelity 1/sqrt(1+epsilon^4), while a sigma3-aligned density is blind.
The six local curvature planes span exactly three positive-chiral su(2) directions.
One hundred Mobius-geodesic sections compose to the same continuously signed endpoint link within 1e-10.
Qiskit reproduces the ordered NumPy path operator, statevector, and density within 1e-10, with no measurements, backend execution, randomness, or advantage claim.
Qiskit retains the operator distinction between +I and -I even though one-qubit density conjugation identifies them; a controlled -I interferometric control detects the central sign.
Strict Mobius translation preserves H4 pair distance; normalized Hadamard is only an amplitude/gauge control; a nonzero SO(2,2) boost preserves the split form but fails the Hilbert-unitary gate.

controls.name: independent Levi-Civita frame control
controls.gate: Construct SO(4) transport columnwise from the existing hyperboloid parallel transporter and compare its self-dual projection with the closed-form link's Bloch adjoint.

controls.name: flat curvature ablation
controls.gate: The same closed polygon in the matched flat R4 global frame returns exactly I.

controls.name: operator before density
controls.gate: Holonomy reports retain the signed SU(2) matrix and Wilson trace; density-only observations cannot certify the central Spin lift.

controls.name: ordered Qiskit realization
controls.gate: Compare matrices directly, never Operator.equiv, against U_(n-1)...U_0.

controls.name: sectional carrier separation
controls.gate: SO(2,2), H4, SU(2)+, qutrit density, and Qiskit circuit carriers remain separately typed.

controls.name: evolved sectional metadata
controls.gate: Use phase 1.2368 as a fixed SU(2) gauge/circuit-order control and generation 100 as the refinement count; jitter 0.19685006 and seed 0b62c6dd remain inert because no operator or invariant is defined for them.

controls.name: fail-closed conditioning
controls.gate: No clipping, renormalizing, polar projection, determinant correction, or silent matrix repair is allowed.

kill_conditions: Any geodesic link is nonunitary, has determinant different from one, or disagrees with the independent Levi-Civita frame projection beyond tolerance.
Reverse-edge or same-geodesic refinement composition changes the continuously signed lift beyond tolerance.
The curved triangle is reported as flat, or the flat control acquires holonomy.
A density-only equality is used to identify +I and -I at the Spin lift.
Qiskit circuit order differs from the declared path product.
A nonunitary or non-SU(2) matrix is repaired rather than rejected.
A split-signature boost is submitted as a one-qubit unitary.
The QB1 qutrit is described as one qubit.
The SU(2)+ holonomy is promoted to a finite-dimensional unitary representation of SO+(4,1).
Any hardware, performance, capacity, cognition, AGI, consciousness, or quantum-advantage interpretation is promoted.
